statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ≥0), 0 < ε → 0 < (ε : ℝ) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (ε : ℝ) = (ε : ℝ≥0∞)
proof:

exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast hε, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal⟩

name: yui_aux_0002
statement: ∀ (q : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set (GDVec (n + 1))), (∑' i : {j : ℕ | (U j).Nonempty}, GDCost q (U i)) = ∑' i, GDCost q (U i)
proof:
classical
intro q U
refine tsum_subtype_eq_of_support_subset (f := fun i : ℕ => GDCost q (U i)) (s := {j : ℕ | (U j).Nonempty}) ?_
intro i hi
change (U i).Nonempty
by_contra hempty
have hz : GDCost q (U i) = 0 := by simp [GDCost, hempty]
exact hi hz

name: yui_aux_0003
statement: ∀ (q : ℝ) (A : Set (GDVec (n + 1))), A.Nonempty → GDCost q A = (Metric.ediam A) ^ q
proof:
intro q A hA
unfold GDCost
exact le_antisymm (iSup_le fun _ => le_rfl) (le_iSup_of_le hA le_rfl)
